edits.value: Backend and data engineer with six years building distributed microservices and data pipelines in production. At Northbeam Logistics, led a Java and Spring Boot migration of a 40-service fulfillment platform onto Kafka and PostgreSQL, cutting cross-team release conflicts 60% and shipping-notification lag from 30 seconds to under 2 seconds. At Anchor Data Systems, rebuilt a 200GB nightly warehouse load with Python, SQL, and change data capture, cutting the load window from 6 hours to 45 minutes for 8 downstream teams.
Senior Backend Engineer · Fulfillment Platform · 40 microservices · Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS

Migrated 5 downstream services from 30-second PostgreSQL polling to Kafka event streaming with idempotent consumers, cutting shipping-notification lag from 30 seconds to under 2 seconds and database polling load 70%.
